license_required.quote: A person may not practice medicine in this state unless the person holds a license issued under this subtitle.

issuing_authority.quote: The Texas Medical Board is an agency of the executive branch of state government with the power to regulate the practice of medicine.

name.quote: The Texas Medical Board is an agency of the executive branch of state government with the power to regulate the practice of medicine.

type.quote: The board consists of 19 members appointed by the governor with the advice and consent of the senate

age_minimum.quote: is at least 21 years of age

moral_character_required.quote: is of good professional character and has not violated Section 164.051, 164.052, or 164.053

degree_required.value: graduate of a medical school located in the United States or Canada and approved by the board
degree_required.quote: is a graduate of a medical school located in the United States or Canada and approved by the board

accrediting_body.value: United States Department of Education recognized accrediting body (LCME/AOA); Accreditation Council for Graduate Medical Education or American Osteopathic Association for postgraduate
accrediting_body.quote: All medical or osteopathic medical education an applicant receives in the United States must be accredited by an accrediting body officially recognized by the United States Department of Education as the accrediting body for medical education leading to the doctor of medicine degree or the doctor of osteopathy degree.

degree_level.quote: is a graduate of a medical school located in the United States or Canada and approved by the board

school_approval_basis.quote: is a graduate of a medical school located in the United States or Canada and approved by the board

credential_pegged.quote: is a graduate of a medical school located in the United States or Canada and approved by the board

required.quote: has either: (A) successfully completed one year of graduate medical training approved by the board in the United States or Canada; or (B) graduated from a medical school located outside the United States or Canada and has successfully completed two years of graduate medical training approved by the board in the United States or Canada

experience_source.quote: has either: (A) successfully completed one year of graduate medical training approved by the board in the United States or Canada; or (B) graduated from a medical school located outside the United States or Canada and has successfully completed two years of graduate medical training approved by the board in the United States or Canada

duration.value: 1 year (domestic graduates); 2 years (foreign medical school graduates)
duration.quote: successfully completed one year of graduate medical training approved by the board in the United States or Canada; or (B) graduated from a medical school located outside the United States or Canada and has successfully completed two years of graduate medical training approved by the board in the United States or Canada

kind.quote: successfully completed one year of graduate medical training approved by the board in the United States or Canada

exams.name: United States Medical Licensing Examination (USMLE)
exams.notes: One of several accepted examinations; must pass each part within 3 attempts (with exceptions) and within 7 years.
exams.quote: the United States Medical Licensing Examination (USMLE) or its successor

exams.name: National Board of Osteopathic Medical Examiners (NBOME) examination
exams.notes: Alternative to USMLE for osteopathic applicants.
exams.quote: the National Board of Osteopathic Medical Examiners (NBOME) examination or its successor

exams.name: Texas Medical Jurisprudence Examination
exams.notes: Required of all applicants; no attempt limit applies to this exam.
exams.quote: The board shall administer the Texas medical jurisprudence examination to all applicants.

interval_years.quote: Each person licensed to practice medicine in this state must register with the board every two years.

required.quote: The board by rule shall adopt, monitor, and enforce a reporting program for the continuing medical education of license holders.

period_years.quote: establish the number of hours of continuing medical education the board determines appropriate as a prerequisite to the registration of a license under this subtitle

value: Pain management and opioid prescribing (at least 2 hours, direct patient care physicians, first two renewal periods and every 8 years thereafter)
Identification and assistance of trafficked persons (at least 1 hour, direct patient care physicians, first renewal period and periodically thereafter)
Forensic evidence collection (optional 2 hours for emergency room physicians)
topical_requirements.quote: A physician licensed under this subtitle who submits an application for renewal of a license that designates a direct patient care practice must complete, in accordance with this section, not less than two hours of continuing medical education regarding safe and effective pain management related to the prescription of opioids and other controlled substances

available.quote: On application, the board shall grant a provisional license to practice medicine in a location described by Subsection (e) to an applicant for a license under this subtitle who is licensed in good standing as a physician in another state.

requirements.value: Texas is a member of the Interstate Medical Licensure Compact (IMLC), allowing expedited licensure for eligible physicians. Additionally, out-of-state applicants in good standing may obtain a provisional license to practice in health professional shortage areas or medically underserved areas. Applicants with 5+ years active practice in good standing may be considered to have satisfied examination requirements regardless of attempt counts.
requirements.quote: The member states of the Interstate Medical Licensure Compact have allied in common purpose to develop a comprehensive process that complements the existing licensing and regulatory authority of state medical boards and provides a streamlined process that allows physicians to become licensed in multiple states

exists.quote: The Texas Medical Board is an agency of the executive branch of state government with the power to regulate the practice of medicine.

national_certification.value: American Board of Medical Specialties (ABMS); American Osteopathic Association Bureau of Osteopathic Specialists
national_certification.quote: specialty board certified by a specialty board that: (A) is a member of the American Board of Medical Specialties; or (B) is a member of the Bureau of Osteopathic Specialists

national_association.value: American Medical Association; American Osteopathic Association
national_association.quote: the standards of: (1) the American Medical Association adopted by that association for its Physician's Recognition Award; or (2) the American Osteopathic Association.

regulatory_model.quote: A person may not practice medicine in this state unless the person holds a license issued under this subtitle.

credential_type.quote: A person may not practice medicine in this state unless the person holds a license issued under this subtitle.

is_mandatory.quote: A person may not practice medicine in this state unless the person holds a license issued under this subtitle.

title_protection.quote: A person, partnership, trust, association, or corporation commits an offense if the person, partnership, trust, association, or corporation, through the use of any letters, words, or terms affixed on stationery or on advertisements, or in any other manner, indicates that the person, partnership, trust, association, or corporation is entitled to practice medicine if the person, partnership, trust, association, or corporation is not licensed to do so.

scope_protection.quote: A person may not practice medicine in this state unless the person holds a license issued under this subtitle.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Committing an act prohibited under Section 164.052 (fraud, deception, impersonation, illegal abortion, etc.)
disciplinary_grounds.quote: commits an act prohibited under Section 164.052

disciplinary_grounds.description: Convicted of or placed on deferred adjudication for a felony or misdemeanor involving moral turpitude
disciplinary_grounds.quote: is convicted of, or is placed on deferred adjudication community supervision or deferred disposition for: (A) a felony; or (B) a misdemeanor involving moral turpitude

disciplinary_grounds.description: Direct or indirect violation of a board rule, as principal, accessory, or accomplice
disciplinary_grounds.quote: commits or attempts to commit a direct or indirect violation of a rule adopted under this subtitle, either as a principal, accessory, or accomplice

disciplinary_grounds.description: Unable to practice medicine with reasonable skill and safety due to illness, drunkenness, drug use, or mental/physical condition
disciplinary_grounds.quote: is unable to practice medicine with reasonable skill and safety to patients because of: (A) illness; (B) drunkenness; (C) excessive use of drugs, narcotics, chemicals, or another substance; or (D) a mental or physical condition

disciplinary_grounds.description: Found by a court judgment to be of unsound mind
disciplinary_grounds.quote: is found by a court judgment to be of unsound mind

disciplinary_grounds.description: Fails to practice medicine in an acceptable professional manner consistent with public health and welfare
disciplinary_grounds.quote: fails to practice medicine in an acceptable professional manner consistent with public health and welfare

disciplinary_grounds.description: Removed, suspended, or disciplined by peers in a professional medical association or by a licensed hospital based on unprofessional conduct or professional incompetence likely to harm the public
disciplinary_grounds.quote: is removed, suspended, or is subject to disciplinary action taken by the person's peers in a local, regional, state, or national professional medical association or society, or is disciplined by a licensed hospital or medical staff of a hospital

disciplinary_grounds.description: Subject to repeated or recurring meritorious health care liability claims evidencing professional incompetence likely to injure the public
disciplinary_grounds.quote: is subject to repeated or recurring meritorious health care liability claims that in the board's opinion evidence professional incompetence likely to injure the public

disciplinary_grounds.description: Holds a license to practice medicine subject to disciplinary action by another state or uniformed services based on acts prohibited under Texas law
disciplinary_grounds.quote: holds a license to practice medicine subject to disciplinary action by another state, or subject to disciplinary action by the uniformed services of the United States, based on acts by the person that are prohibited under Section 164.052 or are similar to acts described by this subsection

disciplinary_grounds.description: Submits a false or misleading statement, document, or certificate in an application for a license
disciplinary_grounds.quote: submits to the board a false or misleading statement, document, or certificate in an application for a license

disciplinary_grounds.description: Presents to the board a license, certificate, or diploma that was illegally or fraudulently obtained
disciplinary_grounds.quote: presents to the board a license, certificate, or diploma that was illegally or fraudulently obtained

disciplinary_grounds.description: Commits fraud or deception in taking or passing an examination
disciplinary_grounds.quote: commits fraud or deception in taking or passing an examination

disciplinary_grounds.description: Uses alcohol or drugs in an intemperate manner that could endanger a patient's life
disciplinary_grounds.quote: uses alcohol or drugs in an intemperate manner that, in the board's opinion, could endanger a patient's life

disciplinary_grounds.description: Commits unprofessional or dishonorable conduct likely to deceive or defraud or injure the public
disciplinary_grounds.quote: commits unprofessional or dishonorable conduct that is likely to deceive or defraud the public, as provided by Section 164.053, or injure the public

disciplinary_grounds.description: Uses an advertising statement that is false, misleading, or deceptive
disciplinary_grounds.quote: uses an advertising statement that is false, misleading, or deceptive

disciplinary_grounds.description: Impersonates a physician or permits another to use the person's license or certificate to practice medicine
disciplinary_grounds.quote: impersonates a physician or permits another to use the person's license or certificate to practice medicine in this state

disciplinary_grounds.description: Directly or indirectly aids or abets the practice of medicine by a person, partnership, association, or corporation not licensed by the board
disciplinary_grounds.quote: directly or indirectly aids or abets the practice of medicine by a person, partnership, association, or corporation that is not licensed to practice medicine by the board

disciplinary_grounds.description: Fails to keep complete and accurate records of purchases and disposals of controlled substances
disciplinary_grounds.quote: fails to keep complete and accurate records of purchases and disposals of: (A) drugs listed in Chapter 481, Health and Safety Code; or (B) controlled substances scheduled in the Comprehensive Drug Abuse Prevention and Control Act of 1970

disciplinary_grounds.description: Writes prescriptions for or dispenses to a person known or should have known to be an abuser of narcotic drugs, controlled substances, or dangerous drugs
disciplinary_grounds.quote: writes prescriptions for or dispenses to a person who: (A) is known to be an abuser of narcotic drugs, controlled substances, or dangerous drugs; or (B) the physician should have known was an abuser of narcotic drugs, controlled substances, or dangerous drugs

disciplinary_grounds.description: Writes false or fictitious prescriptions for dangerous drugs or controlled substances
disciplinary_grounds.quote: writes false or fictitious prescriptions for: (A) dangerous drugs as defined by Chapter 483, Health and Safety Code; or (B) controlled substances

disciplinary_grounds.description: Prescribes or administers a drug or treatment that is nontherapeutic in nature or nontherapeutic in the manner administered
disciplinary_grounds.quote: prescribes or administers a drug or treatment that is nontherapeutic in nature or nontherapeutic in the manner the drug or treatment is administered or prescribed

disciplinary_grounds.description: Fails to adequately supervise the activities of those acting under the supervision of the physician
disciplinary_grounds.quote: fails to supervise adequately the activities of those acting under the supervision of the physician

disciplinary_grounds.description: Delegates professional medical responsibility or acts to a person the physician knows or has reason to know is not qualified by training, experience, or licensure
disciplinary_grounds.quote: delegates professional medical responsibility or acts to a person if the delegating physician knows or has reason to know that the person is not qualified by training, experience, or licensure to perform the responsibility or acts

establishment_regulation_required.quote: A pain management clinic may not operate in this state unless the clinic is certified under this chapter.

definition_quote.value: 'Practicing medicine' means the diagnosis, treatment, or offer to treat a mental or physical disease or disorder or a physical deformity or injury by any system or method, or the attempt to effect cures of those conditions, by a person who: (A) publicly professes to be a physician or surgeon; or (B) directly or indirectly charges money or other compensation for those services.
definition_quote.quote: 'Practicing medicine' means the diagnosis, treatment, or offer to treat a mental or physical disease or disorder or a physical deformity or injury by any system or method, or the attempt to effect cures of those conditions, by a person who: (A) publicly professes to be a physician or surgeon; or (B) directly or indirectly charges money or other compensation for those services.

methods_authorized.quote: 'Practicing medicine' means the diagnosis, treatment, or offer to treat a mental or physical disease or disorder or a physical deformity or injury by any system or method

drug_authority.value: A physician licensed under this subtitle may supply a patient with any drug, remedy, or clinical supply necessary to meet the patient's immediate needs. Physicians may prescribe dangerous drugs, controlled substances (Schedules III-V generally; Schedule II in limited hospital and hospice settings), and may delegate prescriptive authority to APRNs and PAs via prescriptive authority agreements.
drug_authority.quote: A physician licensed under this subtitle may supply a patient with any drug, remedy, or clinical supply necessary to meet the patient's immediate needs.

license_status_types.quote: The board shall adopt rules for the issuance of a license that limits the license holder to the practice of administrative medicine.

foreign_medical_graduate_requirements.value: Foreign medical school graduates must: (1) meet curriculum requirements as determined by a committee of experts selected by the Texas Higher Education Coordinating Board; (2) complete at least two years of board-approved graduate medical training in the US or Canada; (3) hold a valid ECFMG certificate; and (4) demonstrate English proficiency.
foreign_medical_graduate_requirements.quote: A license applicant who is a graduate of a medical school that is located outside the United States and Canada must present proof satisfactory to the board that the applicant: (1) is a graduate of a school whose curriculum meets the requirements for an unapproved medical school as determined by a committee of experts selected by the Texas Higher Education Coordinating Board; (2) has successfully completed at least two years of graduate medical training in the United States or Canada that was approved by the board; (3) holds a valid certificate issued by the Educational Commission for Foreign Medical Graduates; and (4) is able to communicate in English.

postgraduate_training_years_required.quote: has either: (A) successfully completed one year of graduate medical training approved by the board in the United States or Canada

pain_management_education_required.quote: A physician licensed under this subtitle who submits an application for renewal of a license that designates a direct patient care practice must complete, in accordance with this section, not less than two hours of continuing medical education regarding safe and effective pain management related to the prescription of opioids and other controlled substances

opioid_prescribing_limits.value: Physicians may delegate prescribing of Schedule III-V controlled substances for up to 90 days (including refills after physician consultation). Schedule II controlled substances may only be delegated in hospital inpatient/emergency settings or for hospice patients. The board must adopt guidelines for prescribing opioid antagonists.
opioid_prescribing_limits.quote: a physician may delegate the prescribing or ordering of a controlled substance only if: (1) the prescription is for a controlled substance listed in Schedule III, IV, or V; (2) the prescription, including a refill of the prescription, is for a period not to exceed 90 days

pain_management_clinic_registration_requ.quote: A pain management clinic may not operate in this state unless the clinic is certified under this chapter.

telehealth_prescribing_rules.value: A person physically located in another jurisdiction who performs an act that is part of a patient care service initiated in Texas (including telemedicine) is considered to be engaged in the practice of medicine in Texas and is subject to board regulation. The practice of medicine occurs where the patient is located. Rules may be adopted to ensure appropriate care for Medicaid/Medicare patients receiving telemedicine services.
telehealth_prescribing_rules.quote: A person who is physically located in another jurisdiction but who, through the use of any medium, including an electronic medium, performs an act that is part of a patient care service initiated in this state, including the taking of an x-ray examination or the preparation of pathological material for examination, and that would affect the diagnosis or treatment of the patient, is considered to be engaged in the practice of medicine in this state

interstate_medical_licensure_compact_mem.quote: the member states of the Interstate Medical Licensure Compact have allied in common purpose to develop a comprehensive process that complements the existing licensing and regulatory authority of state medical boards and provides a streamlined process that allows physicians to become licensed in multiple states

physician_assistant_supervision_model.quote: A physician may delegate to an advanced practice registered nurse or physician assistant, acting under adequate physician supervision, the act of prescribing or ordering a drug or device as authorized through a prescriptive authority agreement between the physician and the advanced practice registered nurse or physician assistant

physician_assistant_prescriptive_authori.value: Physician assistants may prescribe nonprescription drugs, dangerous drugs, and controlled substances in Schedules III-V (for up to 90 days) pursuant to a prescriptive authority agreement with a supervising physician. Schedule II controlled substances may be delegated only in hospital inpatient/emergency settings or for hospice patients. PAs may not prescribe Schedule II substances outside those settings.
physician_assistant_prescriptive_authori.quote: A physician's authority to delegate the prescribing or ordering of a drug or device under this subchapter is limited to: (1) nonprescription drugs; (2) dangerous drugs; and (3) controlled substances to the extent provided by Subsections (b) and (b-1).

max_physician_assistants_per_supervising.quote: the combined number of advanced practice registered nurses and physician assistants with whom a physician may enter into a prescriptive authority agreement may not exceed seven advanced practice registered nurses and physician assistants or the full-time equivalent of seven advanced practice registered nurses and physician assistants.

malpractice_reporting_required.quote: The board shall review the medical competency of a physician against whom three or more expert reports under Section 74.351, Civil Practice and Remedies Code, have been filed in three separate lawsuits within a five-year period

hospital_privilege_action_reporting_requ.quote: require the review of reports filed with the National Practitioner Data Bank for any report of the termination, limitation, suspension, limitation in scope of practice, or probation of clinical or hospital staff privileges of a physician by: (A) a hospital; (B) a health maintenance organization

compelled_mental_physical_exam_authority.quote: In enforcing Section 164.051(a)(4), the board, on probable cause, shall request the affected physician or applicant to submit to a mental or physical examination by physicians designated by the board.

administrative_medicine_license_availabl.quote: The board shall adopt rules for the issuance of a license that limits the license holder to the practice of administrative medicine.
